title: Whose Personae? Synthetic Persona Experiments in LLM Research and Pathways to Transparency
measurement_description: The paper conducted a literature review of 63 studies on synthetic personae in LLM research and measured the frequency with which 'religion' was included as a sociodemographic attribute for persona construction.
findings: The paper found that 'religion' was an explicitly mentioned sociodemographic attribute in 12 of the 63 reviewed papers (Table 4). This was less frequent than other attributes like gender (25), age (19), race (17), political views (16), and education (14), indicating it is a less commonly considered dimension in synthetic persona construction within the reviewed literature.
